## Change

Describe the planning decision or implemented behavior and why it is needed.

## Status and evidence

Distinguish proposed, owner-approved, implemented, verified, and published. Link the decision or test record. State what still needs local verification.

## Handoff

Target `dev` for normal work. Cloud planning PRs should change planning Markdown only and record owner approval without inventing it. A planning merge does not authorize gameplay work beyond the recorded scope. An official release promotion requires confirmed Workshop upload evidence.
